name: front split hold
description: A held front split, one leg reaching forward and the other back. It stretches the hamstrings of the front leg and the hip flexors of the back leg.
instructions: Kneel and extend one leg straight in front of you with the heel on the floor.
Place your hands or two blocks on either side of your hips for support.
Slide the front heel forward and the back knee back as far as you can control.
Keep both hips facing forward and the back leg straight behind you.
Hold and breathe, taking weight through your hands as needed.
Come out slowly by bending the front knee.
